description: This file defines the Education entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the database table 'ohrm_education'. It includes properties for id and name, and manages a many-to-many relationship with EmployeeEducation entities. The class includes constants for record counts and status values.

classes.name: Education
classes.description: Entity class representing education levels or qualifications, with properties for ID and name, and a collection of associated EmployeeEducation records.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the education record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the education record.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name or description of the education qualification.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name or description of the education qualification.
